description_en: Queries an identity provider synchronization task
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore get-identity-provider-sync-job --workspace-id ws-0123456789abcdef01234 --identity-provider-type DingTalk --task-id 12345678-1234-4234-8234-123456789abc --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetIdentityProviderSyncJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace to which the identity provider belongs
parameters.help_zh: 身份源所属的 AgentCore 工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The identity provider type. DingTalk indicates DingTalk, and Feishu indicates Lark
parameters.help_zh: 身份源类型。DingTalk 表示钉钉，Feishu 表示飞书
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

parameters.help_en: The local task ID of AgentCore returned by CreateIdentityProviderSyncJob. It is not the synchronizationJobId of AgentIdentity. The same workspace and identity provider must be used for the query
parameters.help_zh: CreateIdentityProviderSyncJob 返回的 AgentCore 本地任务 ID，不是 AgentIdentity 的 synchronizationJobId。查询时须使用同一工作空间和身份源
parameters.name: task_id

code.description_en: The business status code of the API request. SUCCESS indicates that the request is successful, but does not indicate that the asynchronous synchronization task is completed
code.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的业务状态码。SUCCESS 表示本次请求成功，不表示异步同步任务已经完成

data.description_en: The business data returned by the request
data.description_zh: 本次请求返回的业务数据

currentStep.description_en: The current execution step of the AgentCore asynchronous task. This field may not be returned if the task has not started
currentStep.description_zh: AgentCore 异步任务当前执行阶段；任务尚未开始执行时可能不返回

failureReason.description_en: The failure summary of the asynchronous task. This field is not returned if there is no failure information. You can use the taskId and requestId for troubleshooting
failureReason.description_zh: 异步任务的失败摘要；无失败信息时不返回。可结合 taskId 和 requestId 排查
failureReason.example: The identity provider synchronization job failed.

status.description_en:
The status of the synchronization task. Valid values:
PENDING: The task is pending execution.
RUNNING: The task is running.
PAUSED: The task is paused.
SUCCESS: The task is successful.
FAILED: The task failed.
CANCELED: The task is canceled.
The first three values are non-terminal states, and the last three values are terminal states. Query the task until it reaches a terminal state to determine the result
status.description_zh: PENDING：待执行；RUNNING：执行中；PAUSED：暂停；SUCCESS：成功；FAILED：失败；CANCELED：已取消。前三者为非终态，后三者为终态；应查询至终态后判断结果

syncedUserCount.description_en: The number of user entries that have been locally read and written or updated, including existing users. This value does not represent the number of newly added users or the synchronization percentage. This field is not returned when no statistics are available
syncedUserCount.description_zh: 本地已读取并写入或更新的用户条目数，包含已有用户；不代表新增人数或同步百分比。尚无统计时不返回

synchronizationJobId.description_en: The downstream synchronization task ID of AgentIdentity. This field is not returned if the task has not been created. It cannot replace the taskId to call GetIdentityProviderSyncJob
synchronizationJobId.description_zh: AgentIdentity 下游同步任务 ID，尚未创建时不返回；不能代替 taskId 调用 GetIdentityProviderSyncJob

taskId.description_en: The local task ID of AgentCore returned by CreateIdentityProviderSyncJob. It is not the synchronizationJobId of AgentIdentity. The same workspace and identity provider must be used for the query
taskId.description_zh: CreateIdentityProviderSyncJob 返回的 AgentCore 本地任务 ID，不是 AgentIdentity 的 synchronizationJobId。查询时须使用同一工作空间和身份源

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the API request. It does not indicate the execution result of the asynchronous task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的 HTTP 状态码，不表示异步任务的执行结果

message.description_en: The response message of the API request
message.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的响应消息

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. Provide this value when you troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求的唯一标识。排查问题时请提供该值

success.description_en: Indicates whether the API request is successful. To determine whether the asynchronous task is completed, query the task status
success.description_zh: 本次 API 请求是否成功。异步任务是否完成应查询任务状态
